Hi everyone,

I’m the creator of 3dtextures.me, and I want to talk to you about the importance of supporting my website through Ko-Fi. As a digital artist or designer, you understand the importance of high-quality textures in your work. They add depth, detail, and realism to your creations, and can make all the difference in your projects.

That’s why I’ve spent countless hours curating a collection of textures that I believe will be useful and valuable to the digital art community. I’ve put my heart and soul into this website, and I’m proud of what I’ve created. But maintaining and expanding 3dtextures.me takes time, effort, and resources, and I could use your support.

This is where Ko-Fi comes in. Ko-Fi is a platform that allows creators like me to receive financial support from their audience. It’s a simple and easy-to-use platform that allows you to make a one-time payment or set up a monthly subscription to support the creators of your choice. The best part? Ko-Fi doesn’t take a cut of the money you donate, meaning that your support goes directly to the creator.

So why support 3dtextures.me through Ko-Fi? By supporting my website, you’re helping to ensure that I can continue to offer high-quality textures and expand the website in the future. You’re also showing your appreciation for the hard work and dedication that I’ve put into creating and maintaining 3dtextures.me.

So if you’ve been using 3dtextures.me and have found it to be a valuable resource, I hope you’ll consider supporting my website through Ko-Fi. Your support, no matter how small, can make a big difference in my life and in the future of 3dtextures.me.

Thank you for your support, and I look forward to continuing to provide you with high-quality textures in the future.

Best,

João

HEAD TO KO-FI FOR SUPPORT

 

Anyone who supports me will be given links to where I keep all my textures and can download them with just one click.

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

Supporters who give 3 or more coffees will have access of my 4K Textures folder (and all the other textures). The link will be valid forever, i.e., you’ll have access to previous textures and future textures.

This link will be given via Paypal email.

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

Thank you for your support and keep creating awesome art!

Checkout my pack with 100 seamless textures + maps!

Welcome to my first pack with 100 textures

This pack contains 100 textures plus generated displacement, normal, ambient occlusion and specularity maps, in a total of 500 images plus a sample render of each texture.

Each texture as a dimension of 2048 x 2048 pixels and every single one of them are seamless/tileable.

This pack consists of several categories with one or more textures per category.
And the categories are:

– Asphalt (1)
– Brick Wall (4)
– Cardboard (2)
– Concrete (3)
– Cork (1)
– Dirt (4)
– Fabric (4)
– Grass (5)
– Lava (2)
– Leather (6)
– Marble (7)
– Metal (17)
– Organic (5)
– Painted Wall (3)
– Pavement (5)
– Plastic (1)
– Roofing (2)
– Rough Rock (7)
– Rubble (3)
– Sand (2)
– Stone Wall (2)
– Tiles (3)
– Wood (11)

Numbers between brackets is the number of textures that category has.

For the render samples of all the textures please head to this shared folder in Google Photos.

http://bit.ly/1P9FSmu

In this folder you can browse among all the textures that this pack has.

 

What will you get in this pack:

– 100 image textures with displacement, normal, ambient occlusion and specularity maps for each of them.
– A sample render of each texture.
– A .blend file with 100 materials, one for each texture.

Keep in mind that my focus was the textures not the material nodes inside the .blend file and that the materials are just an example.

Many of the renders used the displacement map as a source in the Displace Modifier and using a high res mesh. The higher the mesh’s resolution/subdivision the better the displacement.

Thanks and all the best,
